In India [[Shipbuilding]] is an old sector<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ancient Ship-Building & Maritime Trade |url=https://www.infinityfoundation.com/mandala/t_es/t_es_agraw_ships.htm |access-date=2026-03-07 |website=www.infinityfoundation.com}}</ref> where the various types of ship manufacturing currently. There are more than 700 Shipbuilders in India.''SS Jala Usha'', the first modern steamship of free India, was launched from the slipway of the Hindustan Shipyard Limited in Visakhapatnam on March 14, 1948.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Visakhapatnam/sailing-through-the-75-year-history-of-shipbuilding-in-india/article66614566.ece |title=Sailing through the 75-year history of shipbuilding in India |newspaper=The Hindu |date=14 March 2023 |last=Bhattacharjee |first=Sumit |publisher=THG Publishing Pvt Ltd |url-access=subscription |access-date=18 December 2024}}</ref> The first oil tanker built by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) was the ''MV Rani Padmini'', which was delivered in July 1981. This is a list of notable '''shipbuilders and shipyards located in India''':
